_comment: Owner-requested character-CHOICE step: every new-game path (solo Start New Game, hosting -- which is Start New Game on the host's own machine, session.gd never a second entry point -- and Join when this machine has no local character yet) shows a 'Choose Your Character' screen before the world is entered. scripts/ui/title_screen.gd::_load_character_options() reads this list generically and builds one row per entry, so a second character is a JSON entry here, not a UI rewrite.
_comment_four_options: Extended from the original single trainer option to four (owner directive: generate alternate main-character choices Lyra, Kael and Sera). `id` doubles as the `data/config/art.json` key that decides the player's body (trainer_model.gd::_ready() reads Game.local.chosen_character, set from this id the moment it is picked -- see title_screen.gd's two call sites), so each id here must exist as a key there. `trainer`'s id matches art.json's own default/fallback key exactly, rather than a separate 'trainer_default' string, so picking it needs no fallback path.
_comment_fields: `id` is the stable key a future consumer (e.g. a starting-loadout or cosmetic difference) would key off, and the `art.json` body key. `display_name` and `tagline` are shown on the row. `portrait` is optional (`res://assets/ui/portraits/<id>.png`); an option without one draws as a text-only row. Selecting a row is also the confirmation -- the same one-press pattern the Load Game slot list already uses -- so a single option is one press, not a picker plus a separate confirm button.

characters.tagline: Wakes at Grandpa's farmhouse to build a team of five and see the Meadows through.
Curious, bold, always scouting the horizon.
Steadfast, resilient, built for what's next.
